title: Zoning text change for 100-12 Queens Boulevard, Queens
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area at 100-12 Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills, Queens. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would allow a 21-story mixed-use building with about 389 apartments, including 97 income-restricted units, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. The Land Use Committee recommended approval with modifications on November 10, 2026.
